notes: A fresh C death sets lastdeath from time(0); the live scenario restores and sleeps the victim, then reaches this actor line through point_update with the 1-in-6 draw (fight.c:1685; limits.c:489-490; R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5h).
The same C-first draw reaches the wake-scream room act before do_wake; an awake peer receives the exact room bytes (fight.c:1685; limits.c:489-490; R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5h).
The one-to-two-day private dream is asserted by the unit matrix; C's real-time age gate cannot be backdated by the scenario harness (fight.c:1685; dream.c:55-80; R1/R5e/R5h).
The shiver room act is asserted by the unit matrix; no scenario control can advance C time(0) by one day (fight.c:1685; dream.c:55-80; R1/R5e/R5h).
The two-to-three-day private dream is asserted by the unit matrix; C writes lastdeath only on death and compares it with time(0) (fight.c:1685; dream.c:55-88; R1/R5e/R5h).
Both pieces of the room act are asserted by the unit matrix; the oracle pulse advances MUD time, not the real timestamp used by dream() (fight.c:1685; dream.c:55-88; R1/R5e/R5h).
The three-to-five-day private dream is asserted by the unit matrix; fresh scenarios cannot seed the old lastdeath needed for this arm (fight.c:1685; dream.c:55-96; R1/R5e/R5h).
The grunt room act is asserted by the unit matrix; changing scenario pulses cannot move C's wall clock into this window (fight.c:1685; dream.c:55-96; R1/R5e/R5h).
